# Review, pass 1: kebra-nagast-ch109-110 (ch. 109-110)

Reviewer pass 1. Reviewed against packet.md, known-forms.json, novel-forms.json, conventions.md and the published ch. 106a-c, 107, 108 (house renderings: Sheol, Judas, 'sun of righteousness', 'prophesied ... and said', thirty '(pieces)' of silver, ወልዲ 'his son'). No modern translation was opened. Dillmann was not available, so lexical doubts are hedged (?), not settled. The edits were made to units.json by script, on the notes, l and i only; every `t` is untouched, and the joined `t` of all 29 units was checked equal to the packet's Geʿez (chapters 109 and 110, whitespace-normalised).

## Findings refused (no change)

- All units: note length. Before the edits the longest note was 939 characters; after them the longest is 1278 (unit 12), and the validator warns above 1600. The long notes cover quotations with several doubtful words and lead with the citation and the first form; not trimmed.
- Unit 13: it joins the end of Jeremiah with three citations (36 Geʿez words, under the ~45 limit) and has no ፤ inside; cut only at a ፤, so it stays whole.
- Unit 2: ጠዪቆሙ as a gerund (qatilomu pattern) is right; kept.
- Unit 3: the vocative እግዚኦ, ተከሥተ as tä-stem passive, and የአምነነ with -ነ 'us' are as in known-forms; kept.
- Units 1, 2, 12: Psalm, Isaiah and Zechariah/Jeremiah source references (Psalms 22:16-18, 69:21, 12:5, 82:8, 44:26, 68:1, 78:65, 16:10; Isa 53; Zech 12:10; Matt 27:9-10 and Zech 11:12-13) are given with the Greek numbering and match the content; kept. The Deuteronomy 28:66 echo in unit 1 is already hedged (?).
- Units 8, 11, 20, 21, 24, 26: Geʿez, l and i agree and the labels check out; unchanged. In unit 20 the ኰንና imperative is already hedged.
- Unit 28: ወልዲ 'his son' is consistent with ch. 108 and known-forms, and the 'my son' alternative is already flagged (?).
- Unit 14 and 16: left the doxological reading of መራሕከነ / ናዘዝከነ (address to Christ or God) as the draft has it, already hedged (?).
- Titles, about text, p: true on units 0 and 18, final ፨ ፨ ፨ shown as '* * *' in l and dropped from i (as ch. 108): all correct.
